answer: No cask, no cloth, no piece of work is sold until the master has signed the book and the warden has seen the signature. Warrener coney book with warreners attestation is the signature the buyer relies on: six-year book, 12,000 coneys taken, warren accounts, quarterly audit. Sell under a borrowed delta and the buyer is refunded in full, the seller pays the same sum again as a fine and the tide is forfeited to the town, while the jetty is filed in the trade book and read at the fair.
